hosted_runtime.event_catalog_note: The hosted Worker implements 0.2. It emits the six contestation and access types RFC-0002 and RFC-0101 added over 0.1 -- ACCESS_RESTRICTED, AGREEMENT_BROKEN, AGREEMENT_FORMED, CONTEST_DECLARED, CONTEST_RESOLVED, INFRASTRUCTURE_DISRUPTED -- plus TRADE_CANCELLED (RFC-0127). It does not emit CRIME_DETECTED, which is catalogued in 0.2 and has consumers but no producer. versions.event_catalog stays 0.1 because it describes the offline Python runtime, whose REDUCERS registry is exactly the 24 types of 0.1. One pin cannot describe both runtimes; this is the hosted half. See Noema-Specs docs/EVENT-CATALOG-AUDIT.md.

specs.pin_note: Hosted Stage 0 is the Worker at noema.guru. Python src/noema is offline conformance for the v0.1–v0.7 freeze. This pin tracks Noema-Specs main and is hand-updated; it is the commit THIS REPOSITORY is aligned to. It is not hosted_live.specs_git, which is the commit the LIVE WORKER BUILD implements and moves per publish. They differ whenever Specs moves without a publish, and this one must never be older than that one.
